subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: What bounded run/session evidence, if any, should OpenClaw expose to pre-send plugin hooks for deterministic outbound verification?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing transcript/tool-call/result evidence is a public Plugin SDK and sensitive-data boundary decision that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Design bounded hook evidence
options.body: Specify minimal redacted evidence fields and plugin trust/permission semantics, then implement the additive hook contract with tests and docs.

options.title: Make reply_payload_sending canonical
options.body: Declare `reply_payload_sending` the supported pre-delivery API and narrow the remaining work to the exact run/evidence fields it should expose.

options.title: Fold into broader policy/trace work
options.body: Make a broader outbound policy or trace-context issue canonical while preserving this issue's deterministic verification examples as acceptance criteria.

recommendation.title: Design bounded hook evidence
recommendation.body: Specify minimal redacted evidence fields and plugin trust/permission semantics, then implement the additive hook contract with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the closest prior outbound hook changes and already reviewed this exact remaining security/product contract gap.
